text:
The foundation that sustained

my weary life lies thrown to earth.

Oh, how much good ends in a single day!

Oh, how many hopes the wind carries away!


Oh, how idle my thought becomes

when it concerns what might be good for me!

My torment punishes my hope,

as though it were barren, a thousand times.


Most often I surrender; at other times I resist

with such fury, with such new strength,

that I could break a mountain set upon me.


This is the desire that leads me

to wish to see again one day

the one it would have been better never to see.

translation.title: The foundation lies thrown to earth...
